notes: Coordinates are sample-1x px (16px cells). F.sample() re-rendered from the module is pixel-identical to r7/sample-1x.png. All 129 edge roles have distinct pixel hashes. The two r6 defects (strict 4-cycle on corners, mod-4 lattice on straights) are gone: both are now hashed greedy sequences with no positional period. One residual issue is real but minor and does not form a grid. Corner sequences are re-seeded per 32-cell band of the other coordinate, so a staircase that crosses x=32k (NW/NE) or y=32k (SW/SE/in*) can put identical tiles within 3 steps, even adjacent ones. Same-row corners of the same role also share a sequence index, so they are always identical. Both are listed under defects as non-blocking, with a one-line fix. The object-gate PASS is advisory (uncalibrated profile) and is not a human allow. My own renders: /tmp/vqa-r7/ (long-ns-1x.png 80-cell N/S edges, diamond-1x.png r=30 diamond, diamond-nw-2x/diamond-se-2x, bandcross-4x, hole-8x).

ragged_ruin_edge.evidence: Art is unchanged from r6 apart from 4 new corner variants per corner role. In north-edge-4x, slabs are flat and break at uneven depths, with chips and loose pieces lying on the earth. There is no comb or picket. The new corner variants 5-8 in edge-tiles-8x match variants 1-4 in style (whole slabs dropped, no lone triangle shards). On a long diamond (diamond-nw-2x, diamond-se-2x) the diagonals read as an irregular broken line. They are cleaner than the N edge, but acceptable.

no_kerb.evidence: No straight or corner variant in edge-tiles-8x has a continuous dressed rim. Outside the slabs the tile is dirt body plus the lip shadow.

no_square_holes.evidence: The 2x2 hole (cells 9-10, 6-7; hole-8x) reads as a rounded, ragged pit. Slabs and fragments break into it, and there are no cell-aligned notches or straight walls.

seamless.evidence: `flag_dirt_art.py check` prints OK. No border lines or steps show between the dirt yard and edge tiles in sample-2x or in the 80-cell long edge and the r=30 diamond.

no_repeat_grid.evidence: Sample dump: N row y=2, x7..20 is NW8 N2 N5 N6 N11 N9 N N4 N13 N3 N7 N5 N10 NE5. S row y=14 is SW2 S12 S9 S8 S3 S5 S16 S6 S10 S14 S7 S5 S9 S8 S14 S10 SE3. The sample has 0 identical edge pairs within Chebyshev 3. Sequence stats over 200 lines x 400 positions: straight (16 variants), P(same at step d) = 0 for d=1-3, 0.077/0.073/0.066/0.060 for d=4-7, and about 0.062 baseline for d>=8. Identical 2-runs: 0.006 at d=4 vs 0.004 baseline. All 240 bigrams appear, 280-396 each. There is no lattice. Corners (8 variants): P(same) = 0, 0, 0, 0.199, 0.160, 0.127, 0.103 at d=1-7, then about 0.125, a decaying bias rather than a period. Self-similarity on the 80-cell N band (fraction of identical pixels vs shift 16..192px): 0.557-0.614 with no spike at 64/128 (64:0.608, 128:0.609, 144:0.614, others 0.56-0.59). That is at most +0.03 over the median, against a bar of 0.05. The S band ranges 0.35-0.44, likewise with no lattice. Diamond r=30, 32px block identity vs step for NW: steps 1-3 = 0.43/0.44/0.42, steps 4-8 = 0.48/0.50/0.47/0.42/0.45. r6 was 0.75 at step 4. Other corner roles are similar, the step-4 excess vs steps 6-8 is about 0.03-0.06, and pairs at steps 1-3 are depressed by construction. Visually the long diagonals and edges show no period at 2x. Author's shift-selfsim agrees: shifts 16-48 are about 0.42, and 64-144 sit flat at about 0.46 because neighbours within 3 are forced distinct. There is no peak at 64.

beodeul_quality.evidence: Measured on the 80-cell N edge: dirt body luminance is 105.2. The first darker pixel below the dirt (the lip shadow) averages 87.0, which is 17.3% darker. Edge slab tops (y32-44, lum>130) average 171.2 vs 202.2 for body slabs (15% dimmer). On board-new-vs-current-2x it sits plausibly beside the temple-ruins reference (body brightness is pre-existing).

preexisting_issues: Flag body: the joint grid shows on 16px cell borders, and the triangular facet lattice repeats across large courts. This is very visible on the r=30 diamond (diamond-nw-2x).
Flag body slab tops are brighter and higher in contrast than the Beodeul temple-ruins stone.
Dirt body pebble pairs and orange clods repeat on a visible regular lattice (diamond-se-2x).
defects: Minor, non-blocking: corner sequence re-seeds per 32-cell band of q (x for NW/NE/inNW/inNE, y for the rest). A staircase crossing q=32k loses the 3-step guarantee. Example: r=30 diamond NW corners (32,4) and (31,5) are both NW3, adjacent on the same staircase. In 300 random 40x40 blobs, 297 identical same-role corner pairs within Chebyshev 1-3 come from this (out of about 58k such pairs, about 0.5%). Hard to spot at 4x (bandcross-4x), and not a grid.

Minor, non-blocking: same-role corners in the same row (or column) of one band share k, so they are always identical. Example: two inNW at (3,28) and (6,28), 3 apart. 124 such pairs within 3 in the same blob test. These are separate notches, not the same staircase.
fixes: Key the corner band on the staircase invariant, so a 45-degree staircase never crosses a band and different staircases in one row get different sequences. Use line = floor((x+y)/32) for NW/SE/inNW/inSE (x+y is constant along those stairs) and floor((x-y+BIG)/32) for NE/SW/inNE/inSW. Optionally add a hashed offset of q into the sequence index for same-row siblings. Re-verify: no identical pair within 3 on one staircase on a diamond with r>=40.
